articles.summary: Key Permitting Milestones Advancing Under FAST-41 Dr. Anne Duncan Hired as GM, Coosa Graphite Mine Preliminary Mine Planning and Design Work Underway Westwater Resources, Inc. (NYSE American: WWR) , an energy technology and battery-grade natural graphite company (“Westwater” or the “Company”), today announced continued progress related to the Coosa Graphite Mine (“Coosa”) in Coosa County, Alabama. Coosa is advancing as a covered project under FAST-41, which provides a coordinated and transparent framework for federal environmental review and permitting. articles.title: Westwater Resources Reports Strong Progress in Advancing the Coosa Graphite Mine
